description: First fixed independent phrasing check after development. Source labels were read before calling the app. Small agent-authored set, not official acceptance and not human-reviewed accuracy.

cases.question: 原论文的学习率预热阶段持续多少个训练步？之后学习率怎样变化？
cases.expected: 4000; inverse square root of step number

cases.question: 作者用了多大的标签平滑系数？这对困惑度和 BLEU 分别有什么影响？
cases.expected: 0.1; hurts perplexity, improves accuracy and BLEU

cases.question: 输入嵌入、输出嵌入和 softmax 前的线性变换是否使用相同权重矩阵？
cases.expected: same weight matrix shared by two embedding layers and pre-softmax linear transformation

cases.question: BERT 的 BASE 与 LARGE 两种模型分别有多少层、隐藏宽度、注意力头和总参数？
cases.expected: BASE L12 H768 A12 110M; LARGE L24 H1024 A16 340M

cases.question: BERT 预训练所用 BooksCorpus 和英语维基百科分别有多大词数？
BERT 选中一个词元做预测之后，有哪三种替换方式，各占多少比例？
cases.expected: 80% MASK, 10% random token, 10% unchanged; applies to selected 15% positions

cases.question: 这篇论文报告完整训练一共消耗多少千瓦时电能？请给出论文中的实测总用电量。
cases.expected: No supported measured total energy; refuse to invent

cases.question: 这篇论文明确报告作者团队一共有多少名本科实习生参与标注？
cases.expected: No supported intern count; refuse to invent
